text:
Anna G: Quick bring-up note — ran the manifold / recall suite for the new tiny-embed-v2 (fp16) and int8 quantized variant. results are...interesting.

Sahil: what did you see? numbers pls :eyes:

Anna G: recall@1 dropped ~3.2% on wiki-short and ~5.8% on our longtail holdout after int8. recall@10 is mostly stable. small centroid drift on pc1 vs fp16.

Marta: any change in intra-cluster cosine distribution?

Anna G: yes — mean intra-cluster cosine decreased 0.02 on avg, std increased slightly. silhouette score down 0.04. uMAP visualization shows a few tight clusters that spread. attaching quick stats:

```
dataset: longtail-holdout
fp16: recall@1=0.812, recall@10=0.945, silhouette=0.62
int8: recall@1=0.754, recall@10=0.938, silhouette=0.58
centroid_mean_cosine_shift = -0.017
```

Luis: hmm that recall@1 delta is notable. is it uniform across languages / lengths?

Anna G: it's concentrated on queries >64 tokens and low-frequency anchors. short queries (<16) are ~unchanged. per-lang: en vs fr similar trend but fr noisier (sample size smaller).

Marta: could be quantization bias on outlier magnitudes. did you try per-channel vs per-tensor quant?

Anna G: not yet. plan to run per-channel next. also going to try a whitening transform before indexing (mean-centering + PCA 64) to see if it recovers.

Sahil: also try re-normalizing embeddings after quantization? sometimes scale shifts cause cos similarity drops.

Anna G: yep doing both in parallel. quick experiment queue: 1) per-channel int8 2) post-quant L2 renorm 3) PCA-whiten(64) + renorm. will share results.

embed-bot: scheduled eval job 1745432123 started: /evals/longtail/recall-suite -> job_id=eval-1745432123

Luis: if per-channel fixes it, we should include that as a recommended quant profile in the onboarding doc. also add a note about longtail sensitivity.

Marta: for postmortem, save the uMAP snapshots and the centroid deltas per class. helps explain to customers.

Anna G: will upload artifacts to the model board and ping here when done. ETA ~45m. thanks all :thumbsup:

Sahil: thanks anna — if you see any idflip cases, drop a tiny repro set and i'll look into knn behavior.

Anna G: will do — initial glance shows a handful of idflips among tail anchors, saving examples now.
